Privacy policy

Metrado is built to work with as little personal data as possible. This policy says what stays on your phone, what leaves it, and how you can delete it.

Effective date: 2026-10-23 · Version 0.2 (draft)

  1. Who we are

The short version

  • There is no account. Your jobs, clients, rates, photos and signatures stay on your phone.
  • No advertising, no tracking and no analytics tools in the app. We do not sell personal data.
  • Data leaves your phone only when you share a document, when you subscribe through Apple, when you use the satellite map, or when you use the optional invite feature.
  • You can delete everything in the app: Settings › Data › Delete all data.

Who we are

The Metrado app and this website (hassma0k.github.io) are provided by [COMPANY_NAME] ("we", "us"). Privacy contact: alhassan.mu@gmail.com.

What stays on your phone

Your business profile and logo, rate card, clients, jobs, measurements, photos, quotes, invoices, payments and signatures are stored on your device. We cannot see them and we do not receive a copy. If you delete the app or use Delete all data, they are gone, and we cannot recover them.

What leaves your phone, and why

WhenWhat is sent, and to whomWhy
You share a document (PDF or proposal link)The document goes to the app and the person you choose, using your phone's share sheet. A proposal link contains the proposal inside the part of the web address after the # sign. That part is never sent to our website, but the messaging app and the people you send it to can read it.To deliver your quote, proposal or invoice. You decide what to send and to whom.
You start a trial or subscribeApple handles the payment. RevenueCat receives an anonymous app user ID and your purchase status.To unlock Metrado Pro and restore it on your devices.
You use the satellite mapApple Maps receives the address you search and the map area you view. Location permission is optional and used only while the app is open, to centre the map. We do not store your location.To trace a lot and measure its area.
You use Invite (optional)The app registers an anonymous ID and a referral code with our referral service, hosted by Supabase. If you enter a friend's code, the service records it with dates, a count of days the app was active (a daily check while the referral is pending) and an Apple DeviceCheck result that says whether this iPhone has already earned a reward. No names, emails, phone numbers, clients or documents are sent.To give and track referral rewards and to prevent abuse. If the service is not available, the app skips these calls.
You choose a photoThe photo picker gives the app only the photos you select. They stay on your phone unless you share them.For your quotes and logo.

What we never do

  • We do not sell personal data or share it for advertising.
  • The app has no advertising tools and does not track you across other companies' apps or websites.
  • The app has no analytics or crash-reporting tools that collect data about you.
  • The app does not ask for your contacts, your microphone, your camera or your location in the background.

Your clients' data

The names and details of your clients live on your phone and are yours to manage. You decide when to share a document with them, and you are responsible for having a lawful reason to hold and use their data.

This website

The website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub, as the host, may log technical data such as IP addresses when you visit, under its own privacy statement. We set no cookies and load no third-party trackers or fonts. The proposal page (hassma0k.github.io/metrado/p/) reads the proposal from the address in your browser and shows it on your screen. It does not send it anywhere. See the cookie notice.

How long we keep data

  • On your phone: until you delete it or uninstall the app.
  • Referral service: while the referral is active. Delete all data in the app removes your referral records. Reward counts may be kept in anonymised form.
  • Purchase records: Apple and RevenueCat keep them under their own policies and tax law.
  • Support emails: for as long as needed to help you, then deleted.

Your rights

Wherever you live, you can ask us to access, correct, export or delete personal data we hold about you. Because Metrado has no account and keeps your business data on your phone, most of it is already under your control in the app. For anything else, write to alhassan.mu@gmail.com. We reply within 30 days, may ask you to confirm who you are, and will not treat you differently for using your rights. If you are in the EEA or the UK, you can also complain to your local data protection authority. California residents have the rights to know, delete and correct, and we do not sell or share personal information.

Security

Data on your phone is protected by your phone's own security. Connections to our referral service use encryption (TLS). No system is perfectly secure, and we will tell you and the authorities about a breach that affects you, as the law requires.

Children

Metrado is a business tool and is not directed to anyone under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

Changes to this policy

We will post any change here with a new date. If a change is significant, we will say so in the app.
